subject.title: feat: add codexbar cookie refresh CLI command

question: Should CodexBar support a public `cookie refresh` CLI that can refresh browser-derived provider credentials, including the provider set and entitlement-limited failure semantics of `--all`?
rationale: This is a new credential-management capability, not a correction to an established CLI contract; source review cannot decide the acceptable user-facing scope or fallback policy.

options.title: Sponsor a non-destructive refresh command
options.body: Approve the feature only with a provider-driven scope, preservation of the old cache on failed import, and signed/entitlement-capable evidence for both success and failure paths.

options.title: Keep existing cache-clear behavior only
options.body: Decline the new refresh contract and direct users to the current cache-clear and app refresh workflow instead.

options.title: Narrow to a smaller approved provider set
options.body: Approve an initial command only for explicitly supported providers, leaving broader `--all` coverage for a separately reviewed expansion.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a non-destructive refresh command
recommendation.body: Approve the feature only with a provider-driven scope, preservation of the old cache on failed import, and signed/entitlement-capable evidence for both success and failure paths.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied merged-history trail places this contributor closest to the relevant cookie cache, browser import, and CLI integration behavior.
